examples.pie: dʰh₁sbʰós bʰebʰidʰmé h₁yóy nos gʷṓs dédh₃n̥ti.
examples.en: We trust the gods, who give us cattle.

examples.pie: dʰéh₁s ḱód sweh₂dú médʰu ph₃dʰí. h₁íd toy pl̥h₁nṓd kʷérōd ǵʰumé. nu muddʰí priHós-kʷe nos h₁sdʰí.
examples.en: God, drink this sweet mead! We have poured it for you from the full cauldron. Now become glad, and be dear to us.

examples.pie: téḱnom dwís ḱlush₁yé nu bʰh₂dʰí. h₃sléydʰt HeHḱéwih₂ dn̥ǵʰwéh₂s. ménos pró h₁éytu wṓkʷs-kʷe énu h₁éytu.
examples.en: Child, hear twice; then speak. A swift tongue slips. Let the mind go forward, and let the voice go after.

examples.pie: h₂éwsōs pr̥h₂wéh₂ sóh₂wl̥ h₁íh₂m̥ sékʷetor. nu h₁íh₂ pró yéh₂ti h₁íd-kʷe énu h₁éyti. nu h₁íh₂ h₂réweti h₁íd-kʷe n̥sméy priHóm. h₁yód-kʷe h₁r̥sḱétes sth₂mé-ge.
examples.en: Dawn is first, the sun follows her. She goes before, and it comes after. She glows, and it is dear to us. And when they come, we, indeed, rise.

examples.pie: nu gʷówes swóm ḱóymom gʷm̥té. poh₂imḗn usmé wédʰeti. nu wih₁rós énu sékʷetor. h₁regʷesyéti mē h₃slidʰté mē kʷis n̥ḱyéh₁t. nu pótnih₂ gʷṓs dʰwóri h₂mélǵti. nu lewkós h₂éydʰos sédesi dʰégʷʰeti.
examples.en: Now, cattle, come home to your own village! The shepherd leads you. Now the man follows along. It is getting dark. Do not slip away, let no one be lost. At the door the mistress milks the cattle. In the dwelling the bright blaze burns.

root.gloss: to enclose, to encircle; enclosure, fence, belt

examples.pie: wíḱpotey h₁mé mē gʷʰéns. kʷíd moy gʰórtoy nékʷti h₁és? kénkom. téḱneh₂ moy kénketi. sléh₂gʷs kʷid? ne kʷid sléh₂gʷm̥. nu moy ph₂wéni sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe. h₂éǵroy moy h₂éyeri wr̥ǵyḗsi. wr̥ǵyṓh₂ h₂éti-kʷe ne stéh₂yōh₂.
examples.en: Do not kill me, master! Why were you in my enclosure at night? I was hungry. My children are hungry. Did you take anything? I took nothing. Then sit down by my fire and eat. But in the morning you will work in my field. I will work, and I will not steal again.

examples.pie: ǵʰwḗr h₂éwibʰos h₂epó ih₂dʰí. h₁íh₂n̥s mē h₁éps moysóm mē lémbʰs. ḱóymom gʰórtom mē gʷéms gʷowsth₂óm-wē mē gʷéms. dedórḱh₂e-ge te nu me ne dedórḱth₂e. sh₂itós h₁sdʰí nu sélos ih₂dʰí. h₁éy-kʷe h₁régʷos h₂epó bʰugyéh₁t.
examples.en: Wild beast, go away from the sheep! Do not seize them, do not seize the ram. Do not come to the homely enclosure or to the cow-stall. I have seen you indeed; now you do not see me. Be bound! Now go to the marsh. And may he flee away into the darkness!

root.gloss: to produce; to beget; to give birth

examples.pie: kʷís ph₂wéns ǵn̥h₁yétor ḱóymōd-kʷe úd h₁éyti? h₁ím kʷis ǵʰóstoh₁ ne kapyéti. dʰuh₂mós.
examples.en: Who is born of fire and goes up from the home? No one holds him in the hand. Smoke.

examples.pie: kʷíd smḗysi? suHnús moy dʰǵʰyés ǵn̥h₁yéto. ḱḗr moy mówdoh₁ pl̥nh₁tór. gʷíh₃woyh₁t h₂uksyéh₁t-kʷe. gʷm̥dʰí ph₃dʰí-kʷe.
examples.en: Why are you laughing? Yesterday a son was born to me! My heart fills with joy. May he live and grow up! Come and drink!

examples.pie: swésōr toy méwdt. kʷíd méwdt? suHnús h₁ésyeh₂ey dʰǵʰyés ǵn̥h₁yéto. h₁ésmey h₁nómn̥ dʰh₁té? h₁ésmey h₁nómn̥ dʰh₁mé. h₁éy h₁suḱléwēs.
examples.en: Your sister has become joyful! Why has she become joyful? A son was born to her yesterday. Did you set a name for him? We set a name for him. He is Of-Good-Fame.

examples.pie: polh₁éwes péḱesi lewbʰṓs. lewbʰós h₂égʰesi ǵn̥nh₃tór. wíHre lewbʰóm mē dʰrugʰyés.
examples.en: In wealth many are dear. In distress the dear one is known. Do not deceive your dear one.

examples.pie: nu nos woydéye deḱsiwóm. ǵn̥néh₃omes-kʷe tód.
examples.en: Now show us what is right! And let us know it!

examples.pie: ḱerh₂wom wóydh₂e werdʰom-kʷe ne ǵn̥néh₃mi.
examples.en: I know the horned one, and I do not know the word.

examples.pie: gʷréh₂won wéndʰe mē-kʷe Hrumpth₂é.
examples.en: Quern, turn, and do not break!

examples.pie: wiHrós h₂éḱmonm̥ h₂éǵroy widét. h₁ím skélHt gʷréh₂wonm̥-kʷe h₁ésmōd kʷért. gʷréh₂wonm̥ ḱóymom bʰéret. h₁ésyo pótnih₂ h₁ím kʷéḱt méwdt-kʷe.
examples.en: The husband found a stone in the field. He split it and made a quern out of it. He carried the quern home. His wife saw it and became joyful.

examples.pie: h₁n̥gʷnís pékʷtorm̥ h₁éwset. pérwr̥ ne dʰégʷʰet.

examples.pie: h₂éydʰe dʰégʷʰe léwke dʰégʷʰe. dṓm nos ph₂sdʰí h₁ím mē h₁éwses. h₂sowsóm dóru h₁éwse lukdʰí.
examples.en: Burn, fire; burn, bright one! Guard our house; do not burn it! Burn the dry wood; become bright!

examples.pie: só krépos lémbʰt h₁n̥gʷnís-kʷe tód h₁éwset.

examples.pie: wíHre gʷṓm h₂mélǵs? h₁súmenes h₁íh₂m̥ h₂mélǵm̥. nu kʷíd h₁ésyeh₂s h₁ówHdʰr̥ pléh₁dʰeti? nu kʷíd h₂mélǵm̥? káprom h₂mélǵs. gʰrémeti. ne gʰrémeti smḗyti.
examples.en: Husband, did you milk the cow? I milked her, Kindly. Then why is her udder swelling? Then what did I milk? You milked the billy goat. He is angry. He is not angry; he is laughing.

examples.pie: kʷís h₂éǵroy sérpeti? só h₂éwim lémbʰt. ǵʰóstoh₁ ne kapyéti. ǵn̥h₃dʰí. h₁éy h₁ógʷʰis.
examples.en: Who creeps in the field? He seizes a bird, but he does not grasp with a hand. Guess! It is a snake.

examples.pie: h₂éwis bʰerHǵóy sédt wĺ̥kʷom-kʷe spéḱyet.

examples.pie: h₂éwis h₁ógʷʰim ǵnéh₃t só-kʷe h₂eh₂ógʰe.
examples.en: The bird recognized the snake, and it is afraid.

examples.pie: súHnew bʰéwdʰe h₁regʷesyéti. stéh₂dʰh₁om spéḱye wókʷm̥ ḱléwse nu mē légʰs.
examples.en: Be awake, son, be awake, it is getting dark. Look at the herd, listen to the voice! Do not lie down.

examples.pie: kʷíd kóslom woséyeti? tód témHos h₁ésti.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ h₁ludʰés? deywṓs h₁mé h₂léksont ḱwṓ-kʷe h₁mé wédʰet. ǵʰwērés bʰéwgm̥ nésm̥-kʷe.
examples.en: "How did you come?" "The gods protected me, and the dog led me. I fled from the beast and returned home unharmed."

examples.pie: h₂nér kʷíh₁ gʷíh₃wesi? gʷíh₃woh₂ deywṓs-kʷe moy h₁wésuh₂ h₁opéyonti. nu toy pótnih₂ kʷíh₁ gʷíh₃weti? gʷíh₃weti. dyḗws toy h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr dʰéh₁mn̥ h₂léksoyh₁t.
examples.en: Man, how do you live? I live, and the gods give me good things. And your wife, how does she live? She lives. May Sky, the giver of good things, protect your house!

examples.pie: gʷr̥h₃ét h₁ógʷʰis táwrom nu h₃érō h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. wérh₁t h₂éwis tósmey. h₃éron toy h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm kʷíh₁ h₁ésti? tóm gʷʰénm̥. h₁yós h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰénti ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos tósmey h₁ésti.
examples.en: A serpent devoured an aurochs. Then the eagle slew the serpent. A bird said to him: "Eagle, how is your name famous?" "I slew him." Whoever slays the serpent, his fame is imperishable.

examples.pie: bʰréh₂ter kʷóterom h₁éḱwom yéwgoh₂? sénom yugdʰí. h₂yéwHō dedwóye. kʷíd dedwóye? yugóm ne wóyde. h₁ím yugóm wédʰe h₁éwketi-kʷe.

examples.pie: swésor toy h₂ébolm̥ ḱéstroh₁ bʰinddʰí. h₁ím bʰéydm̥. kʷóterom wéḱsi? méǵh₂m̥. nu péh₂urom sléh₂gʷoh₂ méǵh₂s suHrós. nu moy péh₂urom dh₃dʰí. wélh₁s méǵh₂m̥ h₂ḱh₃dʰí.
examples.en: Sister, split the apple with your knife! I have split it. Which of the two do you want? The big one. Then I will take the small one; but the big one is sour! Then give me the small one! You chose; eat the big one!

examples.en: Which of the two paths goes to the river? The path on the right. The left path goes into the hills. Is the right path good for a wagon? It is wide and smooth. Your two oxen will pull it.

examples.pie: kúdʰe h₂r̥ǵn̥tóm gʷm̥sḱéti? wiHrṓs h₁íd neh₂ubʰís wéǵʰonti. kʷíd h₁íh₁ kʷrinh₂té? kʷékʷlons kʷrinh₂més bʰréh₂tēr-kʷe moy swesréy médʰu kʷrinéh₂ti.
examples.en: Where does silver come from? Men bring it in boats. What do you buy with it? We buy wagons, and my brother buys mead for my sister.

examples.pie: h₁éḱwom ḱósmi dinóy kʷrinéh₂mi. kʷíd h₁ésyo wósn̥? h₂nḗr déḱm̥ gʷṓs prḗḱst. tód polh₁ú. h₁éy HeHḱús h₁ésti? HeHḱús h₁ésti. nu h₁ím kʷrinh₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe dṓm h₁l̥h₂dʰí.
examples.en: I am buying a horse today. What is its price? The man asked for ten cattle. That is much! Is it swift? It is swift. Then buy it, and drive it home!

examples.pie: ḱéywe h₁éḱwom kʷrinéh₂mi. kʷíd wósn̥ h₁ésti? dh₃dʰí moy kʷetwórn̥s gʷṓs. dwóh₁ toy gʷówh₁e moysóm-kʷe dédeh₃mi. bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰéh₁omes. h₁éḱwom dukdʰí tóh₁-kʷe ḱóm muddʰí.
examples.en: 'Dear one, I am buying the horse.' 'What is the price?' 'Give me four cattle!' 'I give you two cattle and a ram.' 'Let us make a pledge.' 'Lead the horse and rejoice with it!'

examples.pie: l̥h₂pdʰí lówksna ǵn̥h₃ih₁mé te.
examples.en: Moon, shine; may we know you!

examples.pie: sóh₂wl̥ diwés h₃ókʷ h₁yód h₂n̥rṓm ḱérdh₂ wóydth₂e. nu h₁yód HeHḱúns h₁éḱwons yéwgs h₁yód dʰewséh₂ gʷʰr̥néwsi. h₁yód snígʷʰm̥ tinéh₁si h₁yód dʰoHnéh₂m pékʷesi. n̥sméy h₂ew l̥h₂pdʰí n̥sméy léwkm̥ h₁áydʰi.
examples.en: Sun, eye of Sky! You who know the hearts of men, you who yoke the swift horses, you who warm the animals, you who melt the snow, you who ripen the grain, shine for us again, give us light!

examples.pie: tl̥h₂dʰí súHnew yugóm.
examples.en: Son, lift the yoke!

examples.pie: h₂éwh₂e wetsós ǵeǵónh₁e ne sth₂éh₁yeti. h₂énh₁ti? h₂énh₁ti h₁ésyo skélesh₂ ml̥dúh₂. h₁ím tl̥h₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe gʷṓm próti bʰére. h₁yód dʰéh₁yēti sth₂éh₁yēti. nu dʰéh₁yeti gʷṓws-kʷe h₁ím léyǵʰti. gʷṓws swóm téḱnom ǵn̥néh₃ti.

examples.en: My horses are tired. Is your village far? It is not far. Drive your horses to my house. They will drink water and eat grass. You are a good man.

examples.en: Sister, who gives us milk? The cows and the sheep give it to us. Who gives them grass? Mother Earth gives them grass.
